His own experience in actual service has taught him that these pretenders are useless and ridiculous. This man Stesilaus has been seen by him on board ship making a very sorry exhibition of himself.

65837-on-the-borderland.title: On The Borderland
65837-on-the-borderland.creator: F. Britten Austin
65837-on-the-borderland.description: A book by F. Britten Austin. “What do you think of all this, doctor?” said one of the story-tellers, turning suddenly to a keen-eyed elderly man who had been listening in silence. “As a specialist in mental disorders you must have had a vast experience of delusions of every kind. Is there any truth in all this business of spiritualism, automatic writing, reincarnation and the rest of it? What’s the scientific reason for it all?--for some reason there must be! People don’t tell all these stories just for fun.”

arxiv-2106-13080.title: Partial differential equations from matrices with orthogonal columns
arxiv-2106-13080.creator: David Martínez Torres
arxiv-2106-13080.description: Abstract . We discuss a system of third order PDEs for strictly convex smooth functions on domains of Euclidean space. We argue that it may be understood as a closure of sorts of the first order prolongation of a family of second order PDEs.

arxiv-2204-09406.title: Polarization effects in the total rate of biharmonic ω + 3 ​ ω \omega+3\omega ionization of atoms
arxiv-2204-09406.creator: J. Hofbrucker, S. Ramakrishna, A. V. Volotka, S. Fritzsche
arxiv-2204-09406.description: Abstract The total ionization rate of biharmonic ( ω + 3 ​ ω \omega+3\omega ) ionization is studied within the independent particle approximation and the third order perturbation theory. Particular attention is paid to how the polarization of the biharmonic light field affects the total rate.

arxiv-2401-04671.title: Jahn-Teller driven quadrupolar ordering and spin-orbital dimer formation in GaNb 4 Se 8
arxiv-2401-04671.creator: Tsung-Han Yang, Tieyan Chang, Yu-Sheng Chen, K. W. Plumb
arxiv-2401-04671.description: Abstract The lacunar spinel GaNb 4 Se 8 is a tetrahedral cluster Mott insulator where spin-orbit coupling on molecular orbitals and Jahn-Teller energy scales are competitive. GaNb 4 Se 8 undergoes a structural and anti-polar ordering transition at T Q = {}_{Q}= 50 K that corresponds to a quadrupolar ordering of molecular orbitals on Nb 4 clusters.

arxiv-2404-03569.title: High redshift LBGs from deep broadband imaging for future spectroscopic surveys
arxiv-2404-03569.creator: Hu Zou
arxiv-2404-03569.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hu Zou. Lyman break galaxies (LBGs) are promising probes for clustering measurements at high redshift, z > 2 z>2 , a region only covered so far by Lyman- α \alpha forest measurements. In this paper, we investigate the feasibility of selecting LBGs by exploiting the existence of a strong deficit of flux shortward of the Lyman limit, due to various absorption processes along the line of sight.

arxiv-2404-12462.title: Axiomatic modeling of fixed proportion technologies
arxiv-2404-12462.creator: Xun Zhou Timo Kuosmanen
arxiv-2404-12462.description: Abstract Understanding input substitution and output transformation possibilities is critical for efficient resource allocation and firm strategy. There are important examples of fixed proportion technologies where certain inputs are non-substitutable and/or certain outputs are non-transformable. However, there is widespread confusion about the appropriate modeling of fixed proportion technologies in data envelopment analysis.

arxiv-2405-05078.title: Observation of t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t} production in the lepton+jets and dilepton channels in p p +Pb collisions at s NN = 8.16 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}=8.16 \tev with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2405-05078.description: Abstract This paper reports the observation of top-quark pair production in proton-lead collisions in the ATLAS experiment at the Large Hadron Collider. The measurement is performed using 165 nb -1 of p p +Pb data collected at s NN = 8.16 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}=8.16 TeV in 2016.

arxiv-2408-10547.title: Semi-on-Demand Off-Peak Transit Services with Shared Autonomous Vehicles — Service Planning, Simulation, and Analysis in Munich, Germany
arxiv-2408-10547.creator: Max T.M. Ng, Roman Engelhardt, Florian Dandl, Vasileios Volakakis, Hani S. Mahmassani, Klaus Bogenberger
arxiv-2408-10547.description: Abstract This study investigates the implementation of semi-on-demand (SoD) hybrid-route services using Shared Autonomous Vehicles (SAVs) on existing transit lines. SoD services combine the cost efficiency of fixed-route buses with the flexibility of on-demand services. SAVs first serve all scheduled fixed-route stops, then drop off and pick up passengers in the pre-determined flexible-route portion, and return to the fixed route.

arxiv-2504-20732.title: Bayesian Inference in Quantum Programs
arxiv-2504-20732.creator: Christina Gehnen, Dominique Unruh, Joost-Pieter Katoen
arxiv-2504-20732.description: Abstract Conditioning is a key feature in probabilistic programming to enable modeling the influence of data (also known as observations) to the probability distribution described by such programs. Determining the posterior distribution is also known as Bayesian inference. This paper equips a quantum while-language with conditioning, defines its denotational and operational semantics over infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces, and shows their equivalence.

arxiv-2511-18261.title: LLM Reasoning for Cold-Start Item Recommendation DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation emai; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06
arxiv-2511-18261.creator: Shijun Li, Yu Wang, Jin Wang, Ying Li, Joydeep Ghosh, Anne Cocos
arxiv-2511-18261.description: Abstract . Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown significant potential for improving recommendation systems through their inherent reasoning capabilities and extensive knowledge base. Yet, existing studies predominantly address warm-start scenarios with abundant user-item interaction data, leaving the more challenging cold-start scenarios, where sparse interactions hinder traditional collaborative filtering methods, underexplored.

pmc-10508031.title: Mendelian randomization analysis to analyze the genetic causality between different levels of obesity and different allergic diseases
pmc-10508031.creator: Yujian Li, Xuan Kan
pmc-10508031.description: BackgroundThe causal relationship between obesity and different allergic diseases remains controversial.MethodsThe Two Sample MR package and Phenoscanner database were used to obtain and filter Genome-Wide Association Study (GWAS) data from the Open GWAS database. Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis was used to study the causal relationship between different levels of obesity and different allergic diseases.

pmc-10644661.title: Surveilling brain damage using brain biomarkers in hypoglycemic neonatal calves with diarrhea
pmc-10644661.creator: Merve Ider, Amir Naseri, Mahmut Ok, Alper Erturk, Murat Kaan Durgut, Suleyman Serhat Iyigun
pmc-10644661.description: Hypoglycemia is a condition associated with neonatal diarrhea in calves, leading to increased mortality and neurological clinical signs. The aim of the present study was to determine the development of brain damage in hypoglycemic calves with neonatal diarrhea and the diagnostic and prognostic significance of these biomarkers. Ten healthy and 50 hypoglycemic calves with diarrhea were included in the study.

pmc-11574640.title: Zinc transporter ZnT5 is associated with epithelial mesenchymal transition via SMAD1 in breast cancer
pmc-11574640.creator: Erina Iwabuchi, Yasuhiro Miki, Junyao Xu, Ayako Kanai, Takanori Ishida, Hironobu Sasano, Takashi Suzuki
pmc-11574640.description: Zinc levels in breast cancer tissues have been reported to be higher than those in normal tissues. In addition, the expression levels of zinc transporters, including ZnT5 and ZnT6, are reportedly higher in breast cancer than in normal breast tissues. ZnT5 and ZnT6 also contribute to heterodimer formation and are involved in several biological functions.

pmc-11590192.title: Insights into the protective effect of omega-3 nanoemulsion against colistin-induced nephrotoxicity in experimental rats: regulation of autophagy and necroptosis via AMPK/mTOR and RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL signaling pathways
pmc-11590192.creator: Medhat Taha, Omer Abdelbagi, Tourki A. S. Baokbah, Rehab M. Bagadood, Naif A. Jalal, Rami Obaid, Nawal E. Al-Hazmi, Naeem F. Qusty
pmc-11590192.description: Colistin is considered one of the most effective antibiotics against gram-negative bacteria. However, nephrotoxicity is one of the dose-limiting factors in its treatment. This study aimed to evaluate the outcome of omega-3 nanoemulsion against colistin-induced nephrotoxicity and its possible underlying mechanism.

pmc-12521964.title: High-temperature sintered 3D-printed alumina as mechanically robust supports for MOF catalysis
pmc-12521964.creator: Flora Schöfbeck, Tanja Eder, Wenyi Zeng, Dominik Brouczek, Martin Schwentenwein, Youven Benseghir, Michael R. Reithofer, Jia Min Chin
pmc-12521964.description: We demonstrate the functionalization of high-temperature sintered, 3D-printed α-alumina ceramics with ZIF-8 and MOF-808 to create robust MOF–ceramic composites. Dense α-alumina sintered at 1450–1650 °C can be directly functionalized despite its low surface hydroxyl density. The composites unite MOF activity with the mechanical strength and design freedom of additive-manufactured ceramics.

pmc-12663862.title: Synchronous Primary Hyperparathyroidism and Polycythemia Vera: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-12663862.creator: Maryam Montazeri, Pooria Sobhanian, Seyed Mohammad Sakhaei, Homina Saffar
pmc-12663862.description: Polycythemia vera (PV) is a chronic myeloproliferative neoplasm characterized by increased erythrocytes and commonly associated with JAK2 mutations. Primary hyperparathyroidism (PHPT), which is often caused by a parathyroid adenoma, is a common cause of hypercalcemia. Although unrelated, a potential association between PV and PHPT has been described in the literature.

pmc-13081344.title: Molecular mechanism of Yishen Qingzhuo oral liquid in treating chronic renal failure via the Nrf2/HO-1–mediated ferroptosis pathway
pmc-13081344.creator: Aiping Zhao, Bishan Chen, Chu Lin, Weiming Wang, Hang Su, Yuliang Qiu, Wenjie Zhang
pmc-13081344.description: This study investigated the therapeutic effect and underlying mechanism of Yishen Qingzhuo oral liquid (YSQZ) in a rat model of chronic renal failure (CRF). The CRF model was established by 5/6 nephrectomy. Rats were randomly divided into the sham, CRF, and CRF + low/high-dose YSQZ groups (CRF+YSQZ-L/H). Based on the therapeutic effect, the optimal drug dosage was selected.

pmc-13555401.title: A Predictive Tool Using The Society of Thoracic Surgeons Risk Calculator for Safe Operating Room Extubation After Coronary Bypass Surgery
pmc-13555401.creator: John G. Byrne, Farhaan Chaugle, Thomas W. Kessinger, Curtis S. Dickey, Ali Asghar, Prince Thommen, Shahistha Hyder, Hannaan Chaugle
pmc-13555401.description: BackgroundOperating room extubation (ORE) after coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) has proven benefit. However, predicting which patients should undergo ORE is difficult. We hypothesized that The Society of Thoracic Surgeons (STS) risk scores could be used as a predictive tool for ORE.

pmc-13618072.title: Clinical outcomes of umbilical hernia in patients with liver cirrhosis: A retrospective comparative analysis of management strategies
pmc-13618072.creator: Esraa Arabi, Abdalrhman Qazli, Ali Alamri, Yazed Albogami, Fatmah Alsohaibani, Ibrahim Albabtain, Zeyad Alyousef
pmc-13618072.description: Background Managing umbilical hernia in cirrhotic patients is complex. No prior national studies have examined the outcomes associated with treatment approaches for this demographic.Objectives To evaluate the results of cirrhotic patients with umbilical hernia treated conservatively compared to those who underwent elective surgical hernia repair.

uslaw-usc-t10-s1170.title: 10 U.S.C. § 1170 — Regular enlisted members: minority discharge
uslaw-usc-t10-s1170.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s1170.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 59 (Separation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Upon application by the parents or guardian of a regular enlisted member of an armed force to the Secretary concerned within 90 days after the member’s enlistment, the member shall be discharged for his own convenience, with the pay and form of discharge certificate.

uslaw-usc-t22-s277.title: 22 U.S.C. § 277 — International Boundary Commission, United States and Mexico; study of boundary waters
uslaw-usc-t22-s277.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s277.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 7 (International Bureaus, Congresses, Etc.); Subchapter IV (International Boundary And Water Commission). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The President is authorized to designate the American Commissioner on the International Boundary Commission, United States and Mexico, or other Federal agency, to cooperate with a representative or representatives of the Government of Mexico in.
